description: Runs AIGROW's free AI visibility scan of one business: reads its website, writes the buyer questions a customer would ask an assistant, puts them to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, and reports how often the business was named, a score out of 100, who was named instead and what holds it back. Takes up to a minute. Shares the free scan's limits on aigrow.gg: two new websites an hour per network address (a hosted client shares one among its users), and a daily cap. A city or category makes it a new scan, even of a website scanned before.

category.description: What the business is, for example "dentist" or "CRM software".

city.description: The city or area the business serves, if the website may not say.

language.description: The language to answer in, as an ISO 639-1 code: en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, pl, sv, da or no. Any other code answers in English.

website.description: The business's website address, for example bakery-example.com.

name: check_ai_visibility
title: Check AI visibility
